summary:
Reused #481 alternating countermodel and #599 fixed-roster actualist membership convention rather than repeating a quantifier-shift target. Explicit actual reason membership still permits varying local witnesses and no stable reason. A unique admitted anchor reason plus pairwise overlap with that anchor suffices for one actual token wherever the explanandum exists; a populated sound control satisfies this bridge while violating full ReasonInvariant. The earlier worldwise_and_invariance_implies_stable theorem requires a world of existence and worldwise explanations in addition to ReasonInvariant and concludes only token-only StableExplanation. ReasonInvariant preserves explains, not actual-token membership, so it does not suffice for ActualStable with independently varying token domains. The anchor control establishes only that full ReasonInvariant is unnecessary for the new sufficient anchor criterion. This is set-intersection reasoning on stipulated explanation assignments, not a metaphysical account of reason sufficiency. Source readings paused; no author attribution or complete-history ontology selection. Brute facts remain rivals to local PSR; alternating local reasons remain rivals to stable explanations; neither rival is eliminated philosophically. Root premises retained unchanged; necessary bearer, reason adequacy, intrinsic essence, external bearer and circularity remain separate. Details and exact Lean names in docs/modal-quantifier-shift-models.md.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 7822a209 remains unplaced. The alternating fixture has an admitted reason at every populated bearer/world pair yet no single actual token across the supplied bearer’s existence worlds. ActualStable uses Admitted to restrict its witness to the supplied world-indexed token domain at each world where the bearer exists. ReasonInvariant ranges over all tokens that explain the bearer at the source world and guards the destination by that bearer's existence there. In the overlap fixture, the intrinsic token for false witnesses ActualStable, and circumstance true explains the bearer at true but fails to explain it at false, where the bearer also exists. Both restricted claims are off the root path.
